symptom: `mxcli describe --format svg domainmodel <Module>` draws every association centre to centre; the stored association anchors are ignored (tested with extreme anchor values), so the SVG cannot be used to verify "corner to corner" lines
cause: renderDomainModelSVG computed both line ends from the box centres (edgePointFrom) and never read Association.ParentConnection/ChildConnection, although the backend had parsed them since #872
insight: **The encoding was already measured — reuse it, do not re-derive it**: #872's two findings (search `anchor`) settled that ParentConnection (FROM) / ChildConnection (TO) are "x;y" integer PERCENTAGES of the entity box, 0..100, no -1/auto sentinel, and the loader does not range-check; a blank 11.14.0 app's raw unit still holds `0;54`/`100;54`. So the renderer's job is only `box.x + x/100*w`, applied to the box AS DRAWN (the SVG's widths are its own estimate, and after spread/clamp — a percentage survives that, a pixel offset would not). **nil is the only 'unset'**: every association mxcli writes stores 0;50/100;50, so after the fix almost every real diagram changes, and an mxcli-made FROM-left-of-TO pair now draws from FROM's left edge to TO's right edge, through both boxes — that is the stored data, not a bug in the renderer. **A self-association needs a route, not a line**: centre to centre it was a zero-length line; two anchors on one box joined straight cross the entity, so it walks an outset rectangle the shorter way. Out-of-range anchors are clamped onto the box — an unverified choice (no Studio Pro here), documented in the test. Test the endpoints numerically with a centre-line golden captured BEFORE the change as the unset-anchor control; the anchored cases fail on the old code with the exact reported symptom (every line (400,139)-(190,125) whatever the anchors). Tests `TestDomainModelSVG_AssociationUsesStoredAnchors`, `TestDomainModelSVG_UnsetAnchorsKeepCentreLine`, `TestDomainModelSVG_SelfAssociationUsesStoredAnchors`; example `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1841-domain-model-svg-stored-anchors.mdl`. ako/mxcli#1841, part 1 of upstream #1692
